record.bible_text: The proverbs<WH04912> of Solomon<WH08010>. A wise<WH02450> son<WH01121> maketh a glad<WH08055><WTH8762> father<WH01>: but a foolish<WH03684> son<WH01121> <FI>is<Fi> the heaviness<WH08424> of his mother<WH0517>.<CM>
